instruction.thesis: The BTC put-call exhaustion / reversal thesis (H-069 promoted) predicted a bullish reversal after P/C spike. BTC spot has declined from entry $76,989 to $76,695 (-0.38%) and is now at the 25th percentile of the 24h range and only the 4th percentile of the 7d range — deeply weak positioning. More critically, BTC PM IV has spiked from ~35% to 46.8% in the last 2 snapshots, which represents the vol expansion arriving as downside hedging rather than upside call demand. The thesis was that P/C exhaustion would lead to a bounce; instead, spot has drifted lower while vol expanded on the put side. With the position at -0.38% and approaching the -1.5% stop, and with the vol signal now pointing to continued downside risk rather than reversal, the thesis is invalidated. Closing to preserve capital before the mechanical stop triggers.
